method: Contemporaneous OLS of aligned daily changes over the last <=252 common observations; consecutive common dates only, no forward fill; 70/30 chronological holdout of the same-day fit versus a zero-slope baseline measures stability, not prediction. Associations, not causes or forecasts.
limits: Close times differ by source (Treasury curve, Cboe close, Yahoo futures settlements, equity 4 PM close).
Macro histories are revised series, not point-in-time vintages; no lead/lag claim is made.
Sector baskets use current members (survivorship) and unadjusted prices; probable splits are excluded and counted.

candidate_search.note: Fixed candidate list chosen before fitting; nothing is ranked into the catalog by fit quality.
